DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer secondary to Chronic Venous Insufficiency.

The clinical picture of a chronic, non-healing wound on the medial aspect of the lower leg, combined with a decade of bilateral swelling, a history of DVT, and confirmed chronic venous insufficiency on ultrasound, is classic for this condition. The rolled wound edges and the specific location strongly support this diagnosis over arterial ulcers or pressure injuries. I will proceed with wound debridement and compression therapy.
